title: Ordinary sections comparison from the constants adjunction
statement: Let a:L⊣S, b:L⊣T, c:L⊣V, d:K⊣W, f:K⊣X and p:U⊣R be adjunctions in categories C,D,E. Let j:R⋙T≅X and e be leftAdjointUniq from (b.comp p).ofNatIsoRight j to f. Then the right-adjoint comparison from a to c at RG followed by that from (c.comp p).ofNatIsoLeft e to d equals the comparison from a to b at RG, followed by j_G and the inverse comparison from d to f at G.

source.place: Tag 07A6, lemma-adjoint, and compatibility of the Hom bijections with composition and localization.

proof.text: Postcompose by the comparison from d to f and apply the inverse f Hom equivalence. The two right-adjoint comparison identities reduce the left side to e inverse followed by the composite a counit. Naturality of e moves each source comparison past e inverse. The defining counit equation for leftAdjointUniq identifies the composite b counit with j followed by the f counit. Apply the comparison from a to b and cancel.

theorem sections_comparison
    {C D E : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E]
    {L : C ⥤ D} {U : D ⥤ E} {R : E ⥤ D} {K : C ⥤ E}
    {S T V : D ⥤ C} {W X : E ⥤ C}
    (a : L ⊣ S) (b : L ⊣ T) (c : L ⊣ V)
    (d : K ⊣ W) (f : K ⊣ X) (p : U ⊣ R)
    (j : R ⋙ T ≅ X) (G : E) :
    (a.rightAdjointUniq c).hom.app (R.obj G) ≫
      (((c.comp p).ofNatIsoLeft
        (((b.comp p).ofNatIsoRight j).leftAdjointUniq f)).rightAdjointUniq d).hom.app G =
    (a.rightAdjointUniq b).hom.app (R.obj G) ≫ j.hom.app G ≫
      (d.rightAdjointUniq f).inv.app G
